purpose: Teach: 宮城/大島/荒川/金子/今井/市川/片山/熊谷

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 宮城拠点、大島支店、業績ともに堅調か。
lines.en: Miyagi base and Oshima branch — both tracking solid?
lines.style: Clipped, efficient opening. Measured cadence. Hands likely on desk or folded. Slight pause before the final question, registering confirmation rather than doubt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。荒川営業所、金子さんが新所長で実績を出しています。
lines.en: Yes. Kaneko-san took over Arakawa office and he's delivering the numbers.
lines.style: Straightforward report. Even pacing. Professional but not stiff — the ease of someone relaying facts he knows his boss respects. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今井さんの市川支店、市場開拓が進んでる。
lines.en: Imai-san's Ichikawa branch has good momentum on market expansion.
lines.style: Observational, almost conversational within formality. Light acknowledgment on 「進んでる」 — nodding as he speaks. The tone of noting something genuinely encouraging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 片山さんも、熊谷支店で粘り強い営業を展開しています。
lines.en: Katayama-san as well — steady, determined sales work coming out of Kumagaya.
lines.style: Seamless continuation. Measured tempo. Slight vocal lift on the name, then settling into the substance. Building a picture, not listing. Comfortable in the recitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet finality. Slight nod in the voice. Short, warm approval — not effusive, but genuine. The period falls clearly. Small beat of silence before he might move to the next item.
